If your taxable income isn’t more than $201,750 ($201,775 if married filing separately; $403,500 if married filing jointly) and you’re not a patron of an agricultural or horticultural cooperative, don’t file this form; instead, file Form 8995, Qualified Business Income Deduction Simplified Computation. Otherwise, complete Schedule D (Form 8995-A) before beginning Schedule A. If your taxable income is more than $276,750 ($276,775 if married filing separately; $553,500 if married filing jointly), your specified service trade or business doesn’t qualify for the deduction. If you have more than three trades or businesses, attach as many Schedules A as needed. See instructions. Part I. Other Than Publicly Traded Partnerships (P T P).
